risk_summary: The disclosure presents a materially adverse operating trend, including a 37.6% revenue decline, gross margin compression from 24% to 14%, and Collaboration Products cost of revenue exceeding sales. Management attributes weakness largely to sustained post-COVID demand changes and acknowledges that further declines could materially affect financial condition, results, and cash flows. Quantitative operating data is provided, but forward-looking impacts and certain causal explanations remain qualified and partly non-specific.
